exercises.name: Seated Leg Curl (Machine)

source_english.description: Sit against the leg-curl back pad and draw both lower legs toward the hamstrings under the ankle lever before lowering them.
instructions: Adjust the machine to fit your body and sit on it with your back against the backrest.
Place your lower legs under the padded lever, just above your ankles.
Grasp the handles on the sides of the machine for support.
Keeping your upper legs stationary, exhale and curl your legs up as far as possible.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your hamstrings.
Inhale and slowly lower the lever back to the starting position.
form_cues: Keep the upper arms or thighs still.
source_english.safety_note: Choose resistance that keeps the elbow and wrist path controlled.

source_english.description: Reverse Curl (Cable) curls the palms-down weight toward the shoulders while keeping the upper arms still.
instructions: Attach a straight bar to the low cable and stand facing the machine with knees softly bent.
Grip the bar with an overhand reverse-curl grip and keep the elbows beside the ribs.
Curl the bar toward the shoulders without moving the upper arms.
Pause, then lower the bar slowly until the elbows are straight.
form_cues: Use a steady squeeze at the top.
source_english.safety_note: Choose a load that keeps the wrists and elbows aligned without momentum.

Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your arm back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.

Keep the upper arms elevated and still as you grip the handle.
Curl the forearms toward the shoulders without dropping the elbows.
Lower the handle slowly to the starting position.
form_cues: Use a steady squeeze at the top.
source_english.safety_note: Choose a load that keeps the wrists and elbows aligned without momentum.

dataset_instruction_steps_read: Attach a straight bar to a high pulley cable machine.
Stand facing the machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the bar with an underhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
Keep your elbows close to your sides and your upper arms stationary.
Exhale and curl the bar down towards your forehead, keeping your upper arms stationary.
Pause for a moment at the bottom of the movement, squeezing your biceps.
Inhale and slowly return the bar to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
